translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Rahman
translations.clear-quran: The Most Compassionate
translations.pickthall: The Beneficent

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Kur´an´ı öğretti
translations.clear-quran: taught the Quran
translations.pickthall: Hath made known the Qur'an

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: İnsanı yarattı
translations.clear-quran: created humanity
translations.pickthall: He hath created man

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: ona güzel beyanı belletti
translations.clear-quran: ˹and˺ taught them speech
translations.pickthall: He hath taught him utterance

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Güneş ve Ay hesap iledir
translations.diyanet-isleri: Güneş ve ayın hareketleri bir hesaba göredir
translations.clear-quran: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision
translations.pickthall: The sun and the moon are made punctual

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: çemen, ağaç secde eder dururlar
translations.diyanet-isleri: Bitkiler ve ağaçlar O'nun buyruğuna boyun eğerler
translations.clear-quran: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺
translations.pickthall: The stars and the trees prostrate

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Bak şu güzel göğe, onu yükseltti, mizanı koydu ki
translations.clear-quran: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺
translations.pickthall: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure

transliterations.scholarly: Wa As-Samā'a Rafa`ahā Wa Wađa`a Al-Mīzāna

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: tartıda taşkınlık etmeyesiniz
translations.clear-quran: so that you do not defraud the scales
translations.pickthall: That ye exceed not the measure

segments.content: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Tartıyı adaletle doğru tutun, teraziyi aksatmayın
translations.diyanet-isleri: Tartmayı doğru yapın, tartıyı eksik tutmayın
translations.clear-quran: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure
translations.pickthall: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof

transliterations.easy: Wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan
transliterations.scholarly: Wa 'Aqīmū Al-Wazna Bil-Qisţi Wa Lā Tukhsirū Al-Mīzāna
transliterations.aligned: wa-aqīmū l-wazna bil-qis'ṭi walā tukh'sirū l-mīzāna

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Yeryüzünü mahlukat için serdi
translations.diyanet-isleri: Allah, yeri yaratıkları için meydana getirmiştir
translations.clear-quran: He laid out the earth for all beings
translations.pickthall: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Onda meyvalar, salkım tomurcuklu hurma ağaçları vardır

translations.clear-quran: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks
translations.pickthall: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees

transliterations.easy: Feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam
transliterations.scholarly: Fīhā Fākihatun Wa An-Nakhlu Dhātu Al-'Akmāmi

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Çimli taneler ve güzel kokulu bitkiler vardır

translations.clear-quran: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants
translations.pickthall: Husked grain and scented herb

transliterations.scholarly: Wa Al-Ĥabbu Dhū Al-`Aşfi Wa Ar-Rayĥānu

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: şimdi Rabbinizin hangi nimetlerine yalan dersiniz
translations.diyanet-isleri: Ey insanlar ve cinler! Öyleyken, Rabbinizin nimetlerinden hangisini yalanlarsınız
translations.clear-quran: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny
translations.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: İnsanı fağfur gibi bir salsal (ateşte pişmiş gibi bir kuru çamur)dan yarattı

translations.clear-quran: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery
translations.pickthall: He created man of clay like the potter's

translations.pickthall: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet

translations.clear-quran: yet between them is a barrier they never cross
translations.pickthall: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other)

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Denizde akıp giden ve dağlar gibi yükselen gemiler O´nundur
translations.diyanet-isleri: Denizde yürüyen dağlar gibi gemiler O'nundur
translations.clear-quran: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains
translations.pickthall: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners

transliterations.easy: Wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam
transliterations.scholarly: Wa Lahu Al-Jawāri Al-Munsha'ātu Fī Al-Baĥri Kāl'a`lāmi

translations.clear-quran: Every being on earth is bound to perish
translations.pickthall: Everyone that is thereon will pass away

segments.content: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Yüce ve iyilik sahibi Rabbinin yüzü bakidir

translations.clear-quran: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺
translations.pickthall: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory

transliterations.easy: Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam
transliterations.scholarly: Wa Yabqá Wajhu Rabbika Dhū Al-Jalāli Wa Al-'Ikrāmi

segments.content: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Göklerde ve yerde olanlar O´ndan dilenirler. O, her gün yeni bir tecellidedir
translations.diyanet-isleri: Göklerde ve yerde olan kimseler her şeyi O'ndan isterler; O her an kainata tasarruf etmektedir
translations.clear-quran: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about
translations.pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power

transliterations.easy: Yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan
transliterations.scholarly: Yas'aluhu Man Fī As-Samāwāti Wa Al-'Arđi Kulla Yawmin Huwa Fī Sha'nin
transliterations.aligned: yasaluhu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kulla yawmin huwa fī shanin

translations.diyanet-isleri: Ey insan ve cin toplulukları! Sizin de hesabınızı ele alacağız
translations.clear-quran: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺
translations.pickthall: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn)

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Şimdi Rabbinizin hangi nimetlerine yalan dersiniz
translations.clear-quran: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
translations.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

segments.content: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Ey cin ve insan topluluğu! Göklerin ve yerin çevresinden aşıp geçmeye gücünüz yeterse geçin gidin, (ama) bir güce sahip olmadan geçemezsiniz
translations.diyanet-isleri: Ey cin ve insan toplulukları! Göklerin ve yerin çevresini aşıp geçmeye gücünüz yetiyorsa geçin! Ama Allah'ın verdiği bir güç olmaksızın geçemezsiniz ki
translations.clear-quran: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority
translations.pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction

transliterations.easy: Yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan
transliterations.scholarly: Yā Ma`shara Al-Jinni Wa Al-'Insi 'Ini Astaţa`tum 'An Tanfudhū Min 'Aqţāri As-Samāwāti Wa Al-'Arđi Fānfudhū Lā Tanfudhūna 'Illā Bisulţānin
transliterations.aligned: yāmaʿshara l-jini wal-insi ini is'taṭaʿtum an tanfudhū min aqṭāri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi fa-unfudhū lā tanfudhūna illā bisul'ṭānin

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Üstünüze ateşten bir alev, bir zehir duman salınır; aman dileseniz de kurtulamazsınız
translations.diyanet-isleri: Ey insanlar ve cinler! Üzerinize dumansız bir alev ve ateşsiz bir duman gönderilir de kurtulamazsınız
translations.clear-quran: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another
translations.pickthall: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape

transliterations.easy: Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan

transliterations.aligned: yur'salu ʿalaykumā shuwāẓun min nārin wanuḥāsun falā tantaṣirāni

words.en: you will (be able to) defend yourselves

translations.pickthall: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide

translations.clear-quran: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins

transliterations.easy: Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam
